quote.text: People who love what they do wear themselves down doing it, they even forget to wash or eat.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • The quote reminds us that passion for what we do can be all-consuming; as a parent, it’s vital to nurture your well-being so you can be fully present for your children.
    • In caring for your family, remember that self-care is a foundation for resilience—attending to your own needs ensures you can give love and guidance without burnout.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, the intensity of dedication to your work is admirable, yet it may lead to neglecting personal well-being; balance is essential to sustain your vision and support your team.
    • Effective leadership requires modelling healthy behavior—showing that while passion drives success, periodic reflection and self-care prevent exhaustion and ensure long-term effectiveness.
  • Product Management
    • For the product manager, a deep commitment to innovation and execution is key, but the quote is a reminder to set realistic boundaries to avoid overextending oneself.
    • Strive for a balanced approach that fosters creativity and meticulous attention to detail, while ensuring you allocate time for rest and rejuvenation to maintain peak performance.
